detail.title: Foundations of Artificial Agency and Responsibility
detail.question: What conceptual frameworks allow an artificial intelligence to attribute responsibility for its actions, and how does this relate to agent autonomy?
detail.reason: Compliance with enforced research topic 'responsibility_formation' and expansion of investigation into agent accountability.

detail.title: Moral Agency and Responsibility Formation
detail.question: How do concepts of accountability and moral agency arise in autonomous systems, specifically in contrast to programmed rule-following?
detail.reason: To establish a source-backed foundation for understanding how autonomous architectures might develop or simulate responsibility.
